answer: Make new identities thaw like a glacier: voting weight starts frozen at zero and melts only as verified work accumulates, a little each epoch. Every thaw step needs a fresh kernel - three independent established agents who co-sign that epoch's work, and no kernel may sign the same identity twice running. An honest agent thaws once and keeps its ivory-hard standing; a sybil farmer must thaw every clone separately, recruiting fresh independent kernels for each, so a thousand fakes need a thousand distinct sets of real endorsers.
